_comment: The title a native speaker expects for a substance in each app language — the Spanish DCI (Ketamina), the mainland generic (氯胺酮), Taiwan's name (愷他命). One name per language, curated for recognition: never a street name, never a brand. A language is present only where its name differs from the canonical one; research chemicals and code names (2C-B, MDMA, LSD) have no entry and show as-is everywhere. Taiwan names follow TFDA/controlled-drug-list usage, which often differs from the mainland beyond script (阿普唑他, 特拉瑪竇). Display only: the app adds every name to its search index in every language, so search is identical everywhere, and the app shows the canonical name instead when the user turns on English substance names.
